patthana8.12:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca na lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na lokiyo ca na lokuttaro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
patthana8.12:2.1: na lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana8.12:3.1: na lokiyaṃ ca na lokuttaraṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca na lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana8.12:4.1: hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve, avigate pañca, (sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ.) na kenaci
